newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk, Ventspils oil ports reopen.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk, Ventspils oil ports reopen.

text.p: Russia's Black Sea oil port of Novorossiisk and the Latvian Baltic terminal of Ventspils were open on Monday after closures due to strong winds and high swell, a shipping source said.
The ports are the main exports points for Russian crude oil and products.
Novorossiisk reopened on Sunday morning at 0600 local time having been shut on Thursday evening when winds hit Gale Force seven and the swell rose to two metres.
A crude tanker loaded at the main berth number one on Monday, and another is about to berth, the source said.
Two crude tankers, one of 110,000 tonnes and one of 140,000 tonnes, were due to arrive at the port today for loading at berth one.
Two small tankers were waiting at anchor to load at berth two.
"It's ticking over, things aren't backed up too badly," the source said.
Ventspils, the chief Baltic export port for Russian refined oil products, was also operating normally on Monday after high winds forced the port's closure on Friday.
